I am here in Lindi, and my maize plot is 2.48 hectares. I have some schooling, so I know what fertilizer is, but here by the coast the soil is sandy and most of us do not buy urea or DAP for maize — it costs too much and the rains are not always good enough to make it pay. I will put the little cash I have toward clearing, weeding, and maybe some seed, and I will intercrop with cassava and cowpea like my neighbors, because cassava will feed us if the maize fails. I keep a few chickens and goats, so I will scatter what manure I can gather near the planting holes, and I will weed twice with my children's help.
